# @workspacekit/code

> A code renderer for the file workspace: an editable CodeMirror 6 editor with syntax highlighting for code, configuration and data files.

- API reference: https://adityazero4.github.io/workspacekit/api/code
- Install: `npm install @workspacekit/code @workspacekit/react react react-dom`

## README sections

- Install
- Entry: `codeRenderer()` returns a renderer.
- Standalone use: `CodeViewer` shows one file without a tree or a provider.
- CSS: Import `@workspacekit/react/styles.css` and `@workspacekit/code/styles.css` once each.
- Options: `nonce`: set on the `<style>` elements CodeMirror adds, for a strict `style-src` Content-Security-Policy.
- Vite: No configuration is needed in a build or in the dev server.

## Entry points

- `@workspacekit/code`
- `@workspacekit/code/styles.css` (stylesheet)

## Exports of `@workspacekit/code`

- `CODE_MAX_BYTES`: The largest file the code renderer and the standalone `CodeViewer` open: 10 MiB.
- `CODE_PARTS`: Every element this package renders carries `data-fs-part="<part>"`; these are its part names, all with the `code-` prefix.
- `CodeClassNames`: Extra class names per part of this package, merged after the part's own class.
- `CodeEditor`: A code editor without a `FileSystemProvider`: CodeMirror 6 with syntax highlighting for `fileName` (or `language`), themed by the `--fs-*` tokens.
- `CodeEditorProps`: Props of `CodeEditor`: a controlled `value`, with every standalone viewer prop except `src`.
- `CodePart`: A part name of this package.
- `CodeRendererOptions`: Options of `codeRenderer`.
- `CodeViewer`: Shows a code file read-only without a `FileSystemProvider`.
- `CodeViewerProps`: Props of `CodeViewer`: the standalone viewer props, plus `language` (a name or alias such as `python`, overriding the one picked from `fileName`) and `nonce` for CodeMirror's `<style>` elements under a strict CSP.
- `codeRenderer`: Creates the registry entry for code, configuration and data files, up to 10 MiB, shown in an editable CodeMirror 6 editor (read-only when the viewer says so).
